descriptions.en: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Naramon tree.
descriptions.zh: 通过纳拉蒙之树装饰你的登陆艇。

descriptions.en: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
descriptions.zh: 一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·奈特 的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，梦回者。午夜电波的空中支援系统能够释放强力声波，它能摧毁弱小的敌人，同时也能让强大的敌人陷入眩晕。

descriptions.en: Lead the charge with this chivalrous sumdali.
descriptions.zh: 装备这枚骑士风范的船徽，冲锋在前。

descriptions.en: Bestowed in commemoration of exceptional battlefield achievement. Purged of any malicious code.
descriptions.zh: 为表彰卓越的战场功绩而授予。已清除所有恶意代码。
「布拉喀萨」身上脱落下来的一块碎片，如今装饰着你的登陆艇。

descriptions.zh: 向宇宙宣告你身上带着死亡的印记。

descriptions.zh: 将你的登陆艇改造成与追猎者完美匹配的样子。

descriptions.zh: 通过瓦扎林之浪装饰你的登陆艇。

descriptions.en: Now the Landing Craft is changed, reborn through the energy of the Janus Key.
descriptions.zh: 现在登陆艇已经改变，通过雅努斯之钥的能量重生。

descriptions.en: Fly howling into battle with Voruna Prime's signature sumdali.
descriptions.zh: 伴随着圣装赤影狼母的标志性船徽，咆哮冲入战场。

descriptions.en: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
descriptions.zh: 星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

descriptions.en: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Dorsat skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study Tau regions with rocky or barren terrain.
descriptions.zh: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究陶星系岩石或荒地的地形时，星察就会被装备上脊岩外观。

descriptions.en: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Mesaen skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study hot and volcanic regions of Tau.
descriptions.zh: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究陶星系的炎热火山区域时，星察就会被装备上狱火外观。

descriptions.en: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Fremutar skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study Tau regions with water and other resources that support life.
descriptions.zh: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究陶星系中可维持生命的水资源或其他资源时，星察就会被装备上水道外观。

descriptions.en: The light and dark of the cosmos are etched into this skin for the Parallax Landing Craft.
descriptions.zh: 宇宙间的光与暗蚀刻在了这款星察登陆艇外观上。

descriptions.en: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Albodix skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study cold or dark regions of Tau.
descriptions.zh: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究陶星系的低温区和黑暗区时，星察就会被装备上反照外观。

descriptions.en: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Zenurik crystal.
descriptions.zh: 通过泽努里之晶装饰你的登陆艇。

descriptions.en: Impress fellow Tenno by pulling up to the mission in this striking, streamlined landing craft skin.
descriptions.zh: 使用这款引人注目的流线型登陆艇外观进入任务，来给你的天诺同伴留下深刻的印象。
